spans.s:
r. 1st cl. (अतति)
To go, to move or approach progressively and continually.
With an indicatory इ। अति
(अंतति)
To bind.

f. (-त्ता)
1 A mother.
2 An elder sister.
3 A mother's elder sister.
E.
अत to go, अच, and टाप् aff.

mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं)
1 Taken, accepted.
2

Assumed.
3

Attracted.
E.
आङ् before दा to give, क्त aff.

ind.
Even, thus, or hence, so, from this cause, &c.

m. (-टः)
A precipice.
E.
अ neg. and तट a bank.

mfn. (-थ्यः-थ्या-थ्यं)
Untrue, false, unreal.
E.
अ neg. तथ्य true.

mfn. (-नुः-नुः न्वी-नु)
Large, great, not small or slight.
E.
अ neg. तनु minute.

mfn. (-न्द्रः-न्द्रा-न्द्रः)
Awake, active, alert.
E.
अ neg. तन्द्रा sloth.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Smart, active, energetical.
E.
अ neg. तन्द्रित slothful.

Cool.
2

Unanxious.
3

Unemployed.
4

Unostentatious.
E.
अ neg. तप ardor.

m. (-पः)
Sunshine.
E.
आङ्, तप to heat, to shine, अच् aff.

mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं)
Cool, not heated.
E.
अ neg. तप्त heated.

m. (-र्कः)
Absence of reasoning, want of consideration.
E.
अ neg. तर्क consideration.

Unconsidered.
2

Unexpected, unweighed.
adv. n. (-तं)
Unexpectedly, suddenly.
E.
अ neg. अर्कित considered.

mfn. (-र्क्यः-र्क्या-र्क्यं)
Unsearchable, incomprehensible, inscrutable.
E.
अ neg. तर्क्य to be investigated.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Insatiable.
E.
अ neg. तर्पणीय to be satisfied.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Unsatisfied.
E.
अ neg. तर्पित satisfied.

n. (-लं)
A particular hell or division of the infernal regions, the portion immediately below the earth.
E.
अ neg. and तल bottom.

mfn. (-र्शः-र्शा-र्शं)
Very deep, bottomless.
E.
अ neg. तल bottom, and स्पर्श the touch.

mfn. (-स्पृक्)
See the preceding.

ind.
1 Hence, therefore, from this cause.
2 An interjection of command.
E.
एतद this, and तस् affix; irregular formation.

m. (-सः)
1 Wind, air.
2 The self, the soul.
3 Cloth made from bark.
4 A weapon.
f. (-सी)
1 Common flax, (Linum usitatissimum.)
2 Śaṇa, Bengal sun, a kind of flax, (Crotolaria juncea.)
E.
अत to go, and the Uṇādi affix असच, when fem. with ङीष् added.

m. (-ङ्कः)
1 Fear, apprehension.
2 Disease, sickness.
3 Affliction, pain.
4

Fever.
5

The sound of a drum or tabor.
E.
आङ्, तकि to live in distress, घञ aff.

n. (-नं)
1 Calcining, adding a powder or flux to metals in fusion.
2 The flux so used.
3 Casting any thing into another to effect some change, as butter-milk into fresh milk to turn it.
4 Casting away, destroying.
5 Danger, calamity, as a pestilence or epidemic.
6 Speed, velocity.
7 Gratifying, satisfying.
E.
आङ्, तञ्चु to go, and ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Spread, extended.
E.
आङ् before तन to spread, क्त aff.

f. (-ता)
Stealing, persecuting, murdering, destroying.
E.
आततायिन् and तल् affix; also with त्व affix, आततायित्व.

mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि)
A felon, a thief, a murderer, incendiary, ravisher, &c.
E.
आतत extended, every where, ई to go, and णिनि aff.

n. (-नं)
1 Sight, view.
2 Spreading, expanding.
E.
आङ् before तन to spread, अच् aff.

n. (-त्रं)
A large umbrella of silk or leaves, used in the east as a parasol.
E.
आतप sun-shine, त्र what preserves.

n. (-कं)
A small umbrella, a mat or basket carried on the head as one.
E.
आतपत्र a parasol, and कन् aff.

n. (-णं)
A Catta or Indian parasol.
E.
आतप sun-shine, and वारण preventing.

mfn. (-ष्कः-ष्का-ष्कं)
Dried in the sun, evaporated by the solar heat.
E.
आतप and शुष्क dry.

m. (-वः)
Shade.
E.
आतप and अभाव non-existence.

m. (-रः)
Fare, freight.
E.
आङ्, तृ to cross or pass over, अप् aff.

m. (-रः)
Fare, freight.
E.
आङ्, तृ to cross, affix घञ्.

n. (-णं)
1 Satisfying, satisfaction.
2 Whitening the wall or floor or seat on festival occasions.
E.
आङ्, तृप to satisfy or to be satisfied, ल्युट् aff.

m. (-पी)
A kite.
E.
see the next.

m. (-यी)
A kite.
E.
आङ् before ताय to spread, णिनि affix; it is also read आतापिन्, from तप to be warm.

mfn. (-न्धः-न्धा-न्धं)
1 Humbled, degraded.
2 Perfumed.
E.
आत्त taken, and गन्ध pride; whose pride is taken down.

mfn. (-र्व्वः-र्व्वा-र्व्वं)
Humbled, &c. see the preceding.
E.
as before, गर्व्व pride.
